section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Intelligence as a Moderator', investigates how fluid intelligence influences the effect of 'be creative' instructions on the quality (creativity ratings) and quantity (fluency scores) of ideas. The study, with a sample size of n=141, found that fluid intelligence had a significant main effect on creativity ratings but not on fluency. A significant interaction revealed that 'be creative' instructions amplified creativity more for individuals with higher fluid intelligence, while no interaction was found for fluency.

section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates intelligence as a moderator of creativity and fluency, presenting findings from a single study. It first examines the main effect of fluid intelligence on creativity ratings and fluency, noting that higher intelligence led to better ideas but not more. Subsequently, it explores the interaction between fluid intelligence and 'be creative' instructions, revealing that creativity was highest for individuals with higher fluid intelligence when prompted to be creative, thus exaggerating their advantage. Table 1 provides descriptive statistics for the measures used, including Gf subscales and various fluency and creativity ratings, for a sample size of 141 participants.
